snippet.title: Weeny Wise | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into the magical world of Weeny Wise where co-op adventure, puzzles, and platforming challenges await! In this exclusive demo, available during Steam Next Fest from October 14th to 21rd, join Anneli and Hogo as they discover the secrets of a magical land.

🪄Ready to experience the adventure? Wishlist Weeny Wise now on Steam so you don’t miss out:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2820270/Weeny_Wise/?utm_source=YouTube&utm_medium=YouTube&utm_campaign=YouTube
